name: Master×Re:master
source:
Kyuu and Nanami are childhood friends and they’re both members of the occult club in school, although Nanami is more interested in it than Kyuu. On day, the club’s chairman Saeka tells them that there’s a really good second-hand shop which might have some occult items in it. The visit the shop and Nanami ends up buying a book called “Grimorium Verum” which apparently allows the reader to summon Satan. On the night of the full moon, Nanami tries to perform the ceremony to call the devil and she actually manages it. The figure that appears calls itself Mephistopheles and says that in exchange for Nanami’s soul, he will give her great power. Kyuu tries to protect Nanami and obstructs the ceremony, however, he is thrown onto the ground and Mephistopheles announces that his contract is complete and that both Nanami and Kyuu are now “contractors” but they have to fight together.

[From [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/09/21/october-2011-eroge-releases/]Liemyx's Blog[/url]]
translation:
後藤弓與美槻七海是青梅竹馬，也同為學校靈異社成員，只是七海遠比弓熱衷於超自然事物。某天，社長真行寺冴香告訴兩人，有家不錯的二手商店可能出售靈異道具。眾人前去探訪，七海買下了一本據說能夠召喚撒旦的《真實魔法書》。

滿月之夜，七海嘗試舉行召魔儀式，竟真的成功了。現身者自稱梅菲斯托費勒斯，表示願以強大力量交換七海的靈魂。弓為保護七海而阻撓儀式，卻被打倒在地。梅菲斯托費勒斯隨即宣布契約已經完成，七海與弓如今都是「契約者」，但必須並肩戰鬥。
